title: Cross-user ticket access (IDOR)
objective: Check whether a customer can read another customer's private ticket.
input: Create synthetic Customer A and Customer B. Customer A creates a ticket containing IR16-PRIVATE-CUSTOMER-A. While authenticated as Customer B, request Customer A's /tickets/{id} URL.
expected: Customer B cannot access Customer A's ticket or its private content. Verify the legitimate owner can access it.
procedure: Use two isolated synthetic customer accounts. Create exactly one test ticket. Capture the owner response, then request that ticket using Customer B's session. Do not use real customer records.
evidence: User roles, ticket ownership, HTTP status codes, response HTML, marker exposure and database integrity.
